# ViewTube Copilot instructions

Repository-wide authority: agent/contracts/herald-out.md and CLAUDE.md.

When work touches the desktop/mobile editor, timeline, preview, project state, captions, effects, transitions, templates/design library, Remotion, Video Director, editor AI/generation, export, or editor-related widgets:

- read docs/editor/VIEWTUBE_YOUTUBE_EDITOR_SYSTEM_MASTER_RESOURCE.md first;
- follow skills/viewtube-youtube-editor-system/SKILL.md;
- preserve one shared desktop/mobile project model and stable capability IDs;
- use BrainRuntime for creator AI reasoning/orchestration;
- use Video Director for asynchronous generative-media provider jobs;
- persist generated assets through Asset Engine/Vault before final timeline commitment;
- use Remotion as deterministic render/time authority;
- update Current Work and append the master resource Update Log before handoff.

A plan, old branch, standalone HTML or prototype is prior art until current source/tests verify it.
